milestone.title: mp CLI fixes from the 2026-09-27 grooming pass — W43 dotted step refs, verify-ac python3, list --include validation, scratch recipe, cancel --reason, step add --depends-on-steps

intent.outcome: Six defects hit while grooming M230-M246 are gone: mp validate stops flagging valid dotted step ids, mp plan verify-ac understands python3 and inline code, mp list rejects unknown --include values, the documented scratch recipe works as written, cancelled milestones can record why, and step add accepts the same dependency flag as step update.

problem.description: Grooming 16 milestones on 2026-09-27 surfaced six small mp defects (mp-dogfood-log.md, 2026-09-27 entries). (1) W43 false positives: crates/mp/src/validate/milestone_warnings.rs::extract_milestone_refs builds `cleaned` with is_alphanumeric(), dropping '.', so `S1.2` is checked as `S12` (the dot branch at ~234 is dead). (2) crates/mp/src/commands/plan_verify_ac.rs::resolve_python_script passes prefixes ["python", "python3"]; `python` matches first, so `python3 -c '…'` resolves the script path `3` and reports 'python script not found: 3'; inline `-c` / `-m` forms are not scripts at all. (3) mp list (crates/mp/src/cli/list_show.rs `include: Vec<String>`, consumed in commands/list.rs ~50-53) silently ignores values other than steps / acceptance_criteria / evidence / findings. (4) The scratch recipe `SCRATCH=$(mp scratch new m-update)` in AGENTS.md:240, docs/agent-guide/config-and-profiles.md:93, and docs/agent-guide/core-principles.md:120 captures JSON, not a path. (5) `mp milestone set-status <id> cancelled` has no way to write the existing cancel_reason field (mp-model milestone.rs:678). (6) `mp milestone step add` lacks --depends-on-steps, which step update has (cli/milestone.rs ~521), forcing a second call.

in_scope: W43: keep '.' when extracting S-refs so dotted step ids resolve; unit tests for S1.2 / S2.2.1 resolving and a real typo still warning.

verify-ac: match the longest interpreter prefix first (python3 before python); treat `python/python3 -c …` and `-m …` as inline commands (resolved, no file check); `python3 path/to/script.py` still checks the file.
mp list --include: reject unknown values with a non-zero exit and an error listing the accepted values (steps, acceptance_criteria, evidence, findings).
Scratch recipe: change the three doc sites to `SCRATCH=$(mp scratch new m-update | jq -r .path)` (jq is already used in the agent guide); no CLI change.
`mp milestone set-status <id> cancelled --reason <text>` writes cancel_reason (also in --dry-run output); --reason with any other status is an error; mp show surfaces cancel_reason.
`mp milestone step add … --depends-on-steps S1,S1.1` with the same validation as step update (unknown step ids error).
Document --reason and step add --depends-on-steps in docs/mp/commands.md; CHANGELOG; point the six dogfood entries at this milestone.
out_of_scope: A step --order flag (dependencies already express order; wontfix).
Validating --include on commands other than mp list (mp search --include object is a different contract).
A --path-only / raw output mode for mp scratch new.
Detecting rewrites of approved specs (separate milestone after spec-grill).

acceptance_criteria.description: W43 resolves dotted step ids (S1.2, S2.2.1) against the milestone's steps and still warns on a genuinely missing step.
mp plan verify-ac treats python3/python -c and -m verifications as inline commands and resolves `python3 <script>` against the file (no 'script not found: 3').
mp list milestones --include <unknown> exits non-zero with an error naming the accepted values; the four accepted values keep working.
Every documented scratch recipe extracts the path with jq and the pipeline yields a directory.
acceptance_criteria.verification: ! rg -q 'SCRATCH=\$\(mp scratch new [a-z-]+\)' AGENTS.md docs && rg -q 'mp scratch new m-update \| jq -r \.path' AGENTS.md && bash -c 'S=$(mp scratch new ac-check | jq -r .path) && test -d "$S" && rm -rf "$S"'

acceptance_criteria.description: set-status cancelled --reason writes cancel_reason (and shows it in --dry-run); --reason with another status errors.
step add accepts --depends-on-steps with the same unknown-id validation as step update.
docs/mp/commands.md documents set-status --reason and step add --depends-on-steps; mp tests, clippy, fmt, and consumer-surface lint are clean.
acceptance_criteria.verification: rg -q 'cancelled --reason' docs/mp/commands.md && rg -q 'step add.*--depends-on-steps' docs/mp/commands.md && cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast && cargo clippy -p mp --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && make consumer-surface-lint

design_decisions.choice: Unknown --include values on mp list are a hard error, not a warning
design_decisions.rationale: No caller passes unsupported values (raul passes none; documented --include object belongs to mp search), and hard errors match the --fields contract.

design_decisions.choice: Fix the docs (| jq -r .path) instead of adding a raw-path mode to mp scratch new
design_decisions.rationale: Keeps the JSON-by-default read contract; jq is already used in the agent guide.
